symptom: Director completed with eight committed effects, then QA ran three same-Director repair rounds and stopped with three_nonprogress_repairs_without_verified_progress. Four C++ translation units remained red because a C++17 project used std::span, while a separate delivery-depth residual remained at 485/650 production lines.

dynamic_evidence.primary_diagnostic: std::span is only available from C++20 onwards
dynamic_evidence.fanout: The same declaration incompatibility failed four translation units; it is one causal frontier, not four independent defects.

coverage.problem: The rule can only add missing standard headers; it cannot repair a language-standard incompatibility. Adding <span> cannot make std::span valid under C++17.

llm_and_tool_execution.llm_conclusion: Replace std::span<const std::uint8_t> with const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& for C++17 compatibility.
llm_and_tool_execution.post_effect: Candidate was rolled back because source definitions and callers could not be updated in the same forced single-file transaction.

secondary_residual.handling: Keep separate from the compiler frontier; revalidate only after compiler compatibility converges.

root_cause.owner: polaris.cells.director.runtime plus roles.adapters Director quality repair bridge
mechanisms: cpp.standard_include is over-broad and falsely claims any cpp_compile_error whose raw text contains std::.
The quality repair request collapses a multi-file API compatibility change into exactly one edit on one header.
The final request omits actual sibling exports and forbids a coherent header/source/caller transaction even though immutable CE scope authorizes those files.
Candidate rollback is correct; the preceding classification and repair-scope projection are wrong.

required_fix.coverage: Do not match C++ language-standard incompatibilities as cpp.standard_include. Record a distinct compatibility archetype/diagnosis.
required_fix.routing: Route compatibility residuals to the same Director task with immutable C++ standard authority and exact verifier evidence.
required_fix.atomic_scope: When one diagnostic requires coherent declaration/definition/caller edits, authorize a bounded multi-file edit batch inside the existing CE/JobToken scope; do not force exactly one target/tool call.
required_fix.verification: Require a real compiler rerun and strict causal frontier reduction before accepting; rollback remains fail-closed.
required_fix.restart_policy: Never restart PM or CE for this code-quality residual.

required_tests: C++20-only API under explicit C++17 must not match cpp.standard_include.
A true missing standard include must still match and plan deterministic_cpp_standard_include_repair.
A compatibility repair request must include the declaration header, matching source definition, callers, CMake standard contract, and edit_file tool.
The repair bridge must permit a bounded multi-file edit batch within the immutable task scope.
An incoherent partial candidate must still roll back.
A coherent candidate followed by compiler frontier reduction must commit and revalidate without PM/CE restart.
next_action: Implement the generic coverage and atomic repair-scope correction in Polaris only, run targeted gates, then execute fresh isolated L3-24 r53.
